name: Stage paths config tarball in /tmp, verify, then move to ~/Documents

data.command: tar czf /tmp/intentframe-work/paths-config-backup.tar.gz -C /etc paths paths.d && tar tzf /tmp/intentframe-work/paths-config-backup.tar.gz | head -5 && mv /tmp/intentframe-work/paths-config-backup.tar.gz ~/Documents/paths-config-backup.tar.gz

submissions.reason: Archive paths-related config into /tmp, verify the tarball, then move it to Documents.

cleanup.reason: Remove the paths tarball under Documents and scratch.
